conclusions: CINE AF copy full-time/preAF byte was 1; this is not a motor-activity measurement.
Native S1 affected raw scheduler and cached position; focus correctness was not measured.
Face group 0 remained parsed-invalid; raw face header count was zero during the six complete held observations.
Runtime tracking remained zero; AAT backend/model/publication remained zero. These are not active-tracker failure samples.
AF copy area 4 differs from menu getter area 2; these are distinct domains.
AAT manager state 3 alone does not prove initialized tracking.
The final partial observation stopped for the release deadline, not a failed transport.
S1OFF returns to original AF lifecycle; it does not promise all full-time AF lens activity stops.
